basis: Screened the 272 previously dated series/standalone entries by title, release membership and existing reviewed ranges. Checked the saved publisher descriptions for broad and cross-era candidates. Exclusions are explicit decisions, never title-keyword heuristics. Existing individual ranges remain in episode details for reference.
criteria: Keep a bounded historical narrative even when it spans multiple centuries or decades; show its full reviewed range.
Do not turn unrelated stories collected under a release theme into one continuous historical interval.
Keep broad country/city surveys and comparisons across eras off the timeline. Dates and map locations are independent.

the-world-cup-32-countries.title: The World Cup: 32 Countries
the-world-cup-32-countries.note: A country-by-country collection of unrelated stories, legends and surveys. Its parts do not share a historical period; the World Cup is the release theme, not their historical setting.

national-anthems-2026-world-cup.title: National Anthems: 2026 World Cup
national-anthems-2026-world-cup.note: Separate national anthem histories, from the Dutch Revolt to post-apartheid South Africa. An earliest-to-latest bar would imply a shared narrative that this collection does not have.

world-cup-of-kings-and-queens.title: World Cup of Kings and Queens
world-cup-of-kings-and-queens.note: A competition comparing monarchs across centuries, with an Athelstan profile among the parts. That profile cannot date the whole collection.

england-at-euro-2020.title: England at Euro 2020
england-at-euro-2020.note: Separate surveys of England’s relationships with Germany, Ukraine, Denmark and Italy. The Crimean War episode cannot date the whole release set.

holidays.title: Holidays
holidays.note: A thematic collection that jumps between Roman travel, the Grand Tour, Victorian tourism and modern holidays; it is not one continuous historical period.

the-olympics.title: The Olympics
the-olympics.note: Ancient and modern Olympic traditions are separated by a long historical break. One continuous bar would imply coverage through that break.

portugal.title: Portugal
portugal.note: A survey of the country from Roman Iberia through medieval, imperial and twentieth-century history. Retained as a place history rather than assigning the whole country a period.

amsterdam.title: Amsterdam
amsterdam.note: A walking tour of landmarks and city history across medieval pilgrimage, capitalism, monarchy and postwar society, rather than one bounded event or period.

coronations.title: Coronations
coronations.note: The collection combines ancient ritual origins with examples from medieval to modern coronations. The dated parts do not bound the deep-history opening episode.

disease.title: Disease
disease.note: The opening discussion spans human civilisation, followed by episodes on colonisation and modern pandemics. 1492 only dates part of this collection.

paganism.title: Paganism
paganism.note: The modern-paganism episode is paired with a reverse journey from the Renaissance into deep prehistory. The modern part cannot date the whole collection.

the-history-behind-harry-potter.title: The History Behind Harry Potter
the-history-behind-harry-potter.note: A collection of literary, magical and educational influences across periods. Eighteenth-century school rebellions only date one part, not the series.

ireland-from-the-celts-to-the-easter-ris.note: This collection surveys Ireland from medieval conquest to the twentieth century. It has no single historical focal year, so the full series belongs off the timeline; its episodes retain useful reference dates and map locations.

london.note: This collection surveys London through Roman, medieval and modern places, people and stories. It has no single historical focal year, so the full series belongs off the timeline; its episodes retain useful reference dates and map locations.

4922323b-c339-41dd-a666-ebad0b5179ed.title: China
4922323b-c339-41dd-a666-ebad0b5179ed.note: A broad survey of Chinese civilisation and modern memory, not a narrative bounded by the Shang dynasty and 2020.

5d4ca792-8d87-4301-8bee-a4b473fbe64e.title: History of India in 10 Buildings
5d4ca792-8d87-4301-8bee-a4b473fbe64e.note: A selection of buildings spanning roughly 4,500 years of the subcontinent’s history. A country-wide architectural tour has no single historical setting.

f4e1d59c-1b28-4100-9d28-3a9c329936ec.title: California
f4e1d59c-1b28-4100-9d28-3a9c329936ec.note: A survey of the state’s origins, mythology and modern politics. The earlier catalogue range is a reference sweep, not one bounded event.

fd5491b8-b8d0-43e1-8f2f-cefca3de1568.title: Australia Before Cook
fd5491b8-b8d0-43e1-8f2f-cefca3de1568.note: A survey of settlement, Indigenous history and European encounters before Cook, spanning tens of thousands of years. It does not belong at one prehistoric date.

6215344a79e03f0013fe31b8.title: Ukraine and Russia
6215344a79e03f0013fe31b8.note: A broad survey of the relationship between two countries from the Rus’ era to the present; no single historical setting.

ed17f321-feb6-439f-a085-32407cd68709.title: The British Empire
ed17f321-feb6-439f-a085-32407cd68709.note: A discussion of the empire’s interpretation and continuing legacy, rather than a chronological narrative with a defined beginning and ending.

64242c9a4fcc90001171a6e9.title: African Amazons
64242c9a4fcc90001171a6e9.note: A comparison of Nzinga, Dahomey warriors and Ashanti queen mothers. These are separate histories, not a single continuous event from 1600 to 1900.

6269c60a504dee00135bea9f.title: England & Englishness
6269c60a504dee00135bea9f.note: A discussion of identity through literary, cultural and contemporary examples; the earlier date range should not imply a bounded historical narrative.

629341f80252da00138414f1.title: Jubilees
629341f80252da00138414f1.note: A comparison of selected royal celebrations and their meanings, rather than a continuous narrative from 1809 to 2022.

64a4684e-1492-4e02-87a8-2bbc4712bc4e.title: A Royal Row
64a4684e-1492-4e02-87a8-2bbc4712bc4e.note: A contemporary interview prompts comparisons across royal history. Its release-year context does not date the whole historical discussion.

d7b04e6f-4dc6-4b27-aa9e-aa69b44d2cf9.title: We’re all so 17th Century
d7b04e6f-4dc6-4b27-aa9e-aa69b44d2cf9.note: A comparison between seventeenth-century Britain and contemporary crises, not a history confined to 1600–1699.

f7628c7e-2f11-11ef-915b-47d256ff57ad.title: Modern British Elections (Part 2)
f7628c7e-2f11-11ef-915b-47d256ff57ad.note: The publisher describes campaigning from the twentieth century to the 2024 election, including Boris Johnson, Jeremy Corbyn and Ed Davey. The earlier end of 2000 truncated that stated coverage.
